prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished cute 3D pharmacist bear banner for MITRAREE app. A friendly cream fluffy baby bear with large warm dark eyes, round ears, rosy cheeks and adorable smile, wearing white pharmacist coat over teal scrubs, positioned on right third of scene. CRITICAL ANATOMY AND OCCLUSION: bear is STANDING BEHIND a real substantial pharmacy reception COUNTER, NOT a cut-off torso. BOTH paws rest naturally ON the countertop, shoulders and upper torso clearly connect down behind it; complete counter surface spans entire image horizontally from left to right in the foreground at roughly 78% image height, visibly in front of bear and occluding its lower body. Counter has a thin continuous pale stone top edge and deep teal solid front panel down to bottom of image. The countertop is physically deep and perspective-correct, bear is unmistakably behind it, never floating or cut at waist. No vertical sliced-off table edge through bear, no transparent counter, no visible legs. Pharmacy shelves and warm light on far right behind bear, LEFTMOST 58% is calm naturally deep teal wall #005F69 with minimal detail for white live text. Keep left lower counter front same deep teal so white copy remains readable. No lateral color fades or dark overlay on bear. Generous space above head, bright crisp friendly character. Landscape 3:2. No text, no logos, no UI, no red cross. Bear occupies rightmost 32%, head near 30% down from top, paws around 76% height; natural cohesive 3D scene.

Edit this banner composition only: move the entire bear AND the entire countertop DOWN by about 20% of the canvas height. The thin pale horizontal countertop must sit at 80% canvas height, not at 60%. Bear's head top around 32% canvas height, both paws naturally rest on countertop at 80%. Reduce bear size slightly if needed so ears, face, coat and paws fit naturally; do not distort bear. Keep cute face and pharmacy setting, keep deep teal wall filling left 60%, keep counter spanning full width and teal front down to bottom. Left area above 78% canvas height must be uninterrupted deep teal with NO pale horizontal stripe there, for white text. No text, no overlays, no gradients, no logos. Wide banner.

Change ONLY the material and color of the long foreground countertop in this image: replace the pale white marble horizontal surface and front lip with a rich matte deep teal #005F69 countertop, slightly lighter natural reflections on its upper plane so its physical depth remains visible. Keep the bear's two paws naturally resting on top and the counter clearly in front of lower body. This counter must remain a substantial physical counter, not disappear. Keep bear, face, coat, paws, shelves, composition and lighting exactly unchanged. Left side must remain dark teal behind live white app copy at all vertical positions. No text, no logos, no gradients or overlays.
